Paste a song, get slides

Paste the lyrics as they are. Bible Presenter finds the verses, chorus and bridge, splits long lines, and leaves an empty slide for the instrumental so the screen stays clear.

A separate look for the stream

The projector shows full-screen words. The stream gets lower thirds over your camera. Add one browser input in vMix or OBS and design each look on its own.

Run the service from your phone

Scan the QR code and any iPhone or Android phone becomes a remote. Step through slides, clear the text, black out the screen and pick what comes next. Nothing to install, and the phone and the computer stay in sync.

PowerPoint and PDF, as designed

Slides come in with their own fonts, layout and images. PowerPoint files need LibreOffice on the computer.

Photo and video backgrounds

Put a still or a looping video behind the words. The video keeps playing as the slides change.

Stage display

A monitor for the band and the preacher: the current text, the next slide, the clock and a service timer.

Works with a clicker

Next, previous, blank and show from a presenter remote. At the end of a song, Next moves on to the following item in the service.

Small and quick

Version 3 is rebuilt from the ground up. A smaller download, a faster start and less load on an older church computer.

27 interface languages

Every menu, dialog and message is translated. Switch the language in settings at any time.

// FAQ

Questions? We've got answers.

Is Bible Presenter really free?

Yes. No subscription, no watermark, no locked features. The app updates itself when a new version comes out.

Which Bible translations can I use?

Download any of 1,048 translations in 244 languages from the built-in catalog, or import your own file in Zefania, OSIS or numbered-book XML. Book names follow the language you picked.

How do I get the words into my stream?

Add a Web Browser input in vMix or a Browser Source in OBS pointing to the address shown in the app, for example http://localhost:7777.

What do I need to show PowerPoint files?

Install the free LibreOffice. Bible Presenter uses it to turn each slide into an image, so fonts and layout look the same as in PowerPoint.

Does it run on a Mac?

Yes, on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. The app is not signed by Apple, so the first time right-click it and choose Open, then confirm. After that it opens normally.

Do I need to install anything on my phone?

No. Turn on Remote in the app and scan the QR code. The remote opens in the phone's browser, on iPhone and Android alike. The phone and the computer need to be on the same Wi-Fi.
